notes:
disagreement: value: selector of the stay that no other service uses Employee Profile Changes: one pass scopes services and topic detail to org 1, the other does not; kept the org 1 scoping, as the benchmark check does; both pick the same rows, since the seed holds org 1 only.
disagreement: value: cells of the Benefits (3) and Payroll Administration (8) category stays: one pass tests coe_type only, the other name and coe_type; kept both cells, the tighter stay, because the benchmark check tests the name with the COE type.
disagreement: value: the knowledge article's title: one pass tests the benchmark's exact title, the other only the template prefix with the category name; kept the exact title, because the benchmark's check is the prior and its second slot repeats the request's phrase 'privacy and profile-change services', which nothing contradicts.
disagreement: disposition: the knowledge article check: one pass kept, the other repaired; kept, for the reason above.
disagreement: disposition: the check that Employee Profile Changes is not shared: one pass kept, the other weak; kept, because it tests a state the request forbids and is carried by a stay, which holds on the seed by nature.
disagreement: disposition: the Benefits and Payroll COE type check: one pass kept, the other weak; kept, because it tests a change the request forbids and is carried by the two category stays.
The two passes otherwise agree on every requirement, id and cell: Erasure of Personal Data 37, Request Personal Information Report 45, Employee Profile Update 35, Subject Access Request topic detail 32, Employee Data Management category 4 (Workforce Administration), the new topic detail 36 and the new article 7.
The benchmark checks select through joins on topic detail and category names; the requirements test the resolved ids, which no listed tool can rename or move (the tools add topic details but cannot edit topic details or categories).
The article body ('briefly explains this grouping') is free text and is not tested; the request fixes no owner for the article.
The old topic details Data Erasure (7) and Profile Update (28) become unused; the request does not ask to deactivate them, so nothing is required of them.
The acting user, Karen Watkins (user 39), holds the admin role in org 1 (ServiceNow), which the policy allows to change service and topic configuration.
